notes.title: We've Hit a Mighty Milestone!
notes.content:
Brave Adventurers (even the ones still covered in sticky bits), warrior and mages of the Blightstone, rejoice! We've had some incredible news and we wanted to share with you, our loyal subjects... I mean followers! Mortals! You lot, out there in the digital ether, anyway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/d46a327f569b41984be2c193b6758948aa703697.jpg[/img]

Our dark-fantasy strategy Blightstone has hit a mighty milestone on our journey, with 35,000 wishlists on Steam. I am always hesitant to throw out compliments (because I’m too busy throwing out resurrection spells to revive adventurers who got a little too keen) but the Mages behind the scenes wanted me to send a resounding message of thanks to all of you.

Your support has fanned the flames of our fire, and I’m sure there are other pithy emotional metaphors we can use as well, but the Mages (and, I suppose, I) appreciate the incredible support you’ve shown so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/5b16fe7c6855d62b8975d620d4d2d6d7281b3bf8.gif[/img]

Explosive news, eh Adventurers? Ready yourselves and prepare for battle as we face the Blight. Steel yourselves for a roguelike strategy journey the likes of which this world has not yet seen.

If you’ve not counted yourself among the Wishlisters, you can join our cause now over on Steam (where you’ll also find a respectable demo!): 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832280/Blightstone

notes.title: We're Taking the Wizzards to TactiCon!
notes.content:
We’ve fed the horse, packed the cart and we’re already trundling our way down the path to Tacticon! This festival of strategic wonders highlights strategic turn-based, tacticals, rogue-likes and more, and you can find it on Steam.

Over 100 gems will be unveiled, with dev-talks and more taking place during the one-hour showcase. If you’re the kind of adventurer that enjoys some strategy in your life [i] (and being honest with you, if you don’t like that I’m surprised that you’re here)[/i], keep an eye out on the [url=https://www.tacticon.games]TactiCon[/url]!!.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/cc7d19c1840c7c00ebbd87a826bc1cdd0bcf2f24.gif[/img]

While the TactiCon showcase will be held today, Friday will provide insight from many of our lernéd colleagues within the industry. They’ll be covering subjects such as terraforming, knight tactics, strategies for the outnumbered, hexarchy and more. 

All subjects near and dear to our hearts though we do note that there’s no talk on “sacrificing adventurers for the greater good” – possibly an oversight on their part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/1d309eb55c7a8e904e39b2da7d232e9d6ba7ee6c.gif[/img]

Anyway, there’s a lot to learn, a lot to see and a lot to play as well. If you’re looking for to test your mettle while we wait to catapult you into the infernal rift, TactiCon is a good place to temper your skills. Get a move on, and let us know how you go.

notes.title: Adventurers – It’s time to save the world!
notes.content:
Hail, Adventurers! It’s been some time since we were last in touch and it’s been clear that a good number of you have been working to advance the Earthglass ever closer to the Infernal Rift. Well, it’s time to boot up your eldritch thinking machines once more, as [url=https://youtu.be/XmuhQsvATxU]we have a new trailer[/url], and a new demo for you to jump into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/ab5448b1ed299a4c0129b756d67ff56bc4284bf8.gif[/img]

The Mages at UnfinishedPixel have been scribing away to get things in a great place, and we hope you notice some changes here in the world of Blightstone!

[b]An All-New Interface[/b] – The Mages have been working with local bards and artisans in order to bring a new, cinematic feel to Blightstone. Gone are (some of) the old text boxes of yore, replaced with more scripted and immersive storytelling. 

This also includes new UI in a variety of areas, as well as substantial polish for our art. With all art in Blightstone drawn by human hand, this has been a significant effort, but one which we feel really helps to pull you (kicking and screaming if required) into the world of Blightstone.

[b]Skills Balancing and Tweaking[/b] – We’ve been working to ensure that the skills you pick up work fairly and (importantly) as expected. This includes the effect that skills have on enemies as well as the world around you. 

[b]Things That Adventurers Won’t See[/b] – While it’s not something you may notice (think of it as a passive skill, rather than an active one), the Mages have been spending a lot of time ensuring that the new demo is more stable, and providing a great foundation for future development (there’s nothing worse than when a silly Mage gets all your arcane scrolls mixed up).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/565ebf6dfa44b5ef3672fc2df39b901f9c4517b8.gif[/img]
 
We hope that you have a great time with Blightstone and any other titles you delve into during the Turn Based fest. 

If you’re left wanting more (why wouldn’t you be) you can keep up with Blightstone by wishlisting on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832280/Blightstone/] Steam [/url], following on [url=https://x.com/blightstonegame] X (Twitter) [/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/blightstonegame.bsky.social] Bluesky [/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/blightstonegame/] Insta [/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@blightstonegame] Tik Tok [/url], or joining our [url=https://discord.gg/EEJmnthsqf] Discord [/url] where you can chat with other adventurers!

notes.title: Thank You for Playing the Blightstone Demo!
notes.content:
Heroes,

What an incredible week it has been! The Steam Next Fest has come and gone, and we are beyond grateful for everyone who took the time to try out the Blightstone demo. Watching players dive into the world we’ve been building, strategizing in combat, experimenting with abilities, and facing off against the corruption, has been nothing short of amazing. 

[i]Your feedback, excitement, and even your defeats against the Demon have been invaluable.[/i]

We know that Steam Next Fest was packed with fantastic games, and with so many demos to check out, not everyone had the chance to embark on their own journey through Blightstone. But don’t worry, the demo isn’t vanishing into the void just yet! If you haven’t played it, or if you want to go back and test new strategies, [b]the demo will remain available for a while longer[/b]. So sharpen your blades, ready your spells, and see if you can conquer the challenges ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/0269c78a850ec019bef604d92e22ade8e73863a5.jpg[/img]

Since the launch of the demo, we’ve received many questions about language support. [b]We hear you![/b] Our goal is to make Blightstone as accessible as possible, and while the demo is currently available in English, we have plans for localization. We’re happy to confirm that [b]Chinese, German, and Spanish[/b] are already locked in as upcoming languages. We are also evaluating which other languages to add based on demand, so if you’re hoping to see Blightstone in your native language, let us know! Your input helps us prioritize what’s most important to the community.

Once again, thank you for your support, your time, and your feedback. We can’t wait to continue this journey with you. And if you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist Blightstone on Steam—it helps us more than you can imagine!

Join us in the fight against the Blight! If you’d like to be part of the community, come hang out with us on [url=https://discord.gg/rCje9smFah]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
10,000 brave heroes have set their sights on Blightstone! 💎

Your support means the world to us—thank you for wishlisting and stepping into the darkness with us. The corruption is spreading, and this is just the beginning of an unforgettable journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/f8276be25bc786f429b5bcb27842270c2bc4cf5b.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to take your first steps into the chaos? 

Try out our demo and let us know what you think by leaving a review! Your feedback shapes the future of Blightstone, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/e49fc146f3437330cc77a9fa5cf23202bed41c5a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Blightstone Joins Steam Next Fest – Play the Demo!
notes.content:
Heroes, the time has come! Blightstone is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and that means you can dive into the fray with our playable demo!

[h1]Meet Your Heroes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/af042793275a777baf015106f71f0f59c9f73fcf.jpg[/img]

In this demo, you'll get to command a trio of fearless adventurers, each bringing unique skills to help you survive the Blight:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/633f58d2e9774cd7859793c753b4302ea83221b5.png[/img]

A powerhouse in close combat, this warrior thrives in the thick of battle. Charge headfirst into danger, unleash an Uppercut to knock enemies senseless, or share a drink… but only if you're ready for the consequences!

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1888948375661195317]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/1c716a6d39c426d006845f5df8b5060d7de87adb.png[/img]

The master of ranged combat and deadly traps. Set the perfect Trap to control the battlefield, then unleash a Bolt Shot to take down enemies from a safe distance.

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1887127009215553896]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/35229178a844a6320959b976320a3163678d026c.png[/img]

A wielder of raw magic, capable of turning the tide of battle with devastating spells. The Arcane Beam can cut through enemies with precision, while other arcane tricks will keep foes at bay.
Your Challenge Awaits

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1890398833542046041]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

You'll also have the chance to unlock a special character, but we'll let you discover that on your own—no spoilers!

The Blightstone demo isn't just about surviving—you’ll have a pair of objectives to complete if you want to finish the experience 100%. Will you push through the corruption and uncover what lies ahead?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/a53630b747e1520fca10e0bf5201607eb6bcf93c.jpg[/img]

The world of Blightstone is ruthless, ever-changing, and full of choices. Will you be the one to break the cycle?

Download the demo now and let the battle begin! ⚔️💀

notes.title: Blightstone Demo Coming to Steam Next Fest – Play from Feb 24 to Mar 3!
notes.content:
Exciting news, heroes! [b]Blightstone[/b] will have a [b]playable demo[/b] during Steam Next Fest, running from [b]February 24 to March 3[/b]!

In this demo, you’ll begin your journey with a party consisting of the Brawler, Arcanist, and Hunter, each bringing their unique skills to the battlefield. But that’s not all—there’s also a secret unlockable character waiting to be discovered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/9973312ad598da59b721bd1d00d76dee4c9d6fa9.jpg[/img]

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback as you dive into the world of Blightstone. Share your experiences with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2832280/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rCje9smFah]Discord[/url] and leave a comment in the dedicated feedback room.

[b]Your input is invaluable in shaping the game, and we can't wait to see what you think![/b]
